not_covered.text: Saudi Arabia launches 32 airstrikes in four governorates in Yemen against the Houthis.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launch missiles at the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Azraq, Jordan, reporting damage to maintenance facilities, deployment areas, and hangars. Jordan says its forces have intercepted 18 Iranian missiles

not_covered.topic: Death and state funeral of Harald V
not_covered.text: The state funeral of King Harald V takes place at the Oslo Cathedral in Oslo, Norway.
A train collides with a truck at a level crossing in Sokolniki Suche, Poland, killing one person and injuring 20 others.
Fourteen people are killed and eleven others are injured in an explosion at a weapons depot in Sarmada, Syria.

Five people are killed when a fire breaks out aboard a passenger ferry off Coron, Palawan, Philippines. The coast guard rescues 42 people from the vessel, which carried 117 passengers and 17 crew members.
Two people are killed and extensive damage is caused after an explosion at a hydroelectric power station in Piotta, Ticino, Switzerland.

Peninsular Spain records its hottest summer since the State Meteorological Agency's measurements began in 1961, with an average temperature of {{convert|24.5|C|F}} and 61 heatwave days from June through August.

not_covered.topic: Syria and weapons of mass destruction

Apple Inc. unveils the iPhone 18 Pro, the first during John Ternus's tenure as CEO, and the iPhone Duo, the line's first foldable smartphone, thinnest and with the largest display.
